steps.question: What stories did Mr. Choudhary tell about ‘Shanti Bhawan’?

questionMeaning.hi: चौधरी ने शांति भवन के बारे में क्या कहानियाँ सुनाईं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Choudhary ne Shanti Bhawan ke baare mein kya kahaaniyaan sunaayin?

options: that the dead owner comes back at night
steps.answer: that the dead owner comes back at night

steps.question: Does Dr. Dass believe in Mr. Choudhary's stories?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या डॉ. दास चौधरी की कहानियों पर विश्वास करते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Dr. Dass Choudhary ki kahaaniyon par vishwaas karte hain?

steps.question: How does he plan to find out the truth?

questionMeaning.hi: वे सच कैसे पता करने की सोचते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Woh sach kaise pata karne ki sochte hain?

options: by spending a night in the house
by reading a book about ghosts
steps.answer: by spending a night in the house

steps.question: What happens in Shanti Bhawan after midnight?

questionMeaning.hi: आधी रात के बाद शांति भवन में क्या होता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Aadhi raat ke baad Shanti Bhawan mein kya hota hai?

options: Someone dressed in white comes into the room.
steps.answer: Someone dressed in white comes into the room.

steps.question: What does Dr. Dass say to the White Visitor?

questionMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास सफ़ेद मेहमान से क्या कहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass safed mehmaan se kya kehte hain?

options: Go away. I want to finish this book.
I am very afraid of you.
steps.answer: Go away. I want to finish this book.

steps.question: How does Dr. Dass find out the truth?

questionMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास सच कैसे पता करते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass sach kaise pata karte hain?

options: He throws his book and pulls the white cloth off the Visitor's face.
He runs out of the house.
steps.answer: He throws his book and pulls the white cloth off the Visitor's face.

instruction.en: Match the answers in B with the questions in A

pairs.left: I feel sorry for Mr. Choudhary, don't you?

meaning.hi: मुझे चौधरी पर तरस आता है, तुम्हें नहीं? / नहीं।
meaning.hinglish: Mujhe Choudhary par taras aata hai, tumhe nahi? / Nahi.

pairs.right: I think Mr. Choudhary was trying to cheat.

meaning.hi: क्यों नहीं? / मुझे लगता है वह धोखा देना चाहते थे।
meaning.hinglish: Kyon nahi? / Mujhe lagta hai woh dhokha dena chahte the.

pairs.left: Do you think Dr. Dass was right?

meaning.hi: क्या डॉ. दास सही थे? / हाँ।
meaning.hinglish: Kya Dr. Dass sahi the? / Haan.

pairs.left: Dr. Dass taught him a lesson, didn't he?

meaning.hi: डॉ. दास ने उन्हें सबक सिखाया, है ना? / हाँ।
meaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass ne unhe sabak sikhaaya, hai na? / Haan.
